path_redaction_note: Machine-specific paths have been sanitized: checkout paths are repo-relative; /example/artifacts/location-N and /example/toolchain are fictional locations scoped to this record. Measurements, revisions, and recorded hashes are unchanged.
baseline_changes: Only identical examples/cursor_traversal.rs and examples/cursor_traversal/fixture.rs copied into an isolated archive and built with its own target directory. Baseline sources and Cargo files checked against git, and both fixture copies checked byte-for-byte before measurement.
updated_engine: Working-tree streaming single-trail cursors through one UNWIND with plain WITH projections and filters on either side; one encoded list and its live input row retained per trail, consuming projections executed per member.
method: Three sequential fresh-process trials per engine, fixture and consumption mode; release builds. Engine order alternates and mode order rotates between trials. All builds/tests finished before measurements. Each process builds a fresh in-memory graph. Query timing includes planning, snapshot setup, decoding, validation and cleanup, excludes fixture setup. First-row latency is time until the first owned row reaches the consumer. Peak RSS and elapsed wall time cover the entire child process, including graph setup.
fixture: A chain with two parallel NEXT relationships per hop. Node expansion at depth 10 yields 2046 trails and 20480 members. Scalar range expansion at depth 7 and fanout 128 yields 254 trails and 32512 members; at depth 1 and fanout 32768 it yields 2 trails and 65536 members. Plain WITH stages precede and follow UNWIND. Full consumption verifies exact per-depth multiplicity and member sums/squared sums. First mode verifies one one-hop result. Options allow 1000000 explored states and 1 GiB cumulative payload, retaining default memory limit. Scalar final projections; no final path hydration.

queries.unwind-nodes: MATCH p=(:Start)-[:NEXT*]->(b) WITH p AS trail,b WHERE b.id >= 1 UNWIND nodes(trail) AS n WITH length(trail) AS hops,b.id AS endpoint,n.id AS member RETURN hops,endpoint,member
queries.unwind: MATCH p=(:Start)-[:NEXT*]->(b) WITH length(p) AS hops,b.id AS endpoint UNWIND range(1,$fanout) AS member WITH hops,endpoint,member RETURN hops,endpoint,member
